subject: Pilot: Runtime callflow & structured output pilot — kickoff and MAP
messages:
From: Sanjeev Rao <sanjeev@medintel.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya@medintel.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Sep 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot: Runtime callflow & structured output pilot — kickoff

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the performance on streaming + tool calling looked promising. Priya and I reviewed internal priorities and we think a short pilot (4–6 weeks) validating: (1) streaming latency under 200ms tail for single-user flows, (2) tool-calling reliability for our triage integrator, and (3) structured JSON outputs for our downstream parsers would give us confidence to move a feature into production.

Attached is a rough requirements doc (pilot-requirements.docx) with sample transcripts and the parser schema we currently use. What we need from Redwood to proceed:
- A mutual action plan with milestones (kickoff, schema freeze, integration sprint, UAT, closeout)
- A recommended runtime config for streaming + tool calling (batching/kv cache guidance)
- Ownership matrix for who will run the integration tests and who triages issues

Can we schedule a kickoff next week? We’re aiming to start integration work the week of 9/27.

Best,
Sanjeev Rao
Head of Integrations
MedIntel

Attachment: pilot-requirements.docx (docx, ~48KB)
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Sanjeev Rao <sanjeev@medintel.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya@medintel.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot: Runtime callflow & structured output pilot — kickoff

Hi Sanjeev + Priya,

Thanks for the clear asks and the requirements doc — that helps a lot. Monica, Connor and Marcus are looped in from success/eng to own delivery. below is a proposed Mutual Action Plan (MAP) we can tweak on the kickoff:

Mutual Action Plan (proposal)
- Week 0 (9/27): Kickoff + env setup — Redwood provides a dedicated pilot namespace (hosted) and a sandbox API key.
- Week 1 (10/4): Schema harmonization — exchange schema-v1.json (attached) and agree on normalization rules.
- Week 2 (10/11): Integration sprint — MedIntel runs adapter against Redwood streaming endpoints; Redwood provides a reference tool-calling adapter.
- Week 3 (10/18): UAT + load sweep — coordinated tests to validate tail latency and error handling; capture traces.
- Week 4 (10/25): Closeout + next steps — share metrics, opt-in for reserved capacity or recommendations.

Deliverables from Redwood:
- redwood-pilot-plan.pdf (pilot runbook + recommended runtime flags)
- schema-v1.json (initial structured-output contract)
- test harness (small repo link in kickoff doc)

Owners (suggested)
- Redwood PM/owner: Evelyn Hart — overall delivery and customer liaison
- Redwood engineering lead: Connor O'Brien — runtime config, test harness support
- Redwood CS: Monica Patel — success criteria, UAT coordination
- Redwood infra: Marcus Lin — quotas, access and metrics retention settings
- MedIntel lead: Sanjeev Rao — integration ownership, test execution
- MedIntel QA: Priya Shah — UAT coordination and acceptance

I’ll attach a draft pilot plan and the starting schema. Can we confirm a 45-min kickoff on Tue 9/28 or Wed 9/29? If either works we’ll send a calendar invite with the Drive link and a short pre-kick checklist.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Customer Success, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-pilot-plan.pdf (pdf, ~120KB); schema-v1.json (json, ~4KB)
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot: Runtime callflow & structured output pilot — kickoff (internal plan)

Connor / Marcus — quick internal alignment before the external kickoff. Below are tasks I pulled out from Evelyn's MAP and who I propose owns them. Please reply with any conflicts.

Internal task list (owner)
- Provision pilot namespace + API key (Marcus) — include 30-day metrics retention and per-minute token quota (we should leave headroom for their load sweep).
- Provide reference tool-calling adapter + example payloads (Connor) — include one synchronous and one async example.
- Runtime flag recommendation (Connor) — suggested kv cache TTL, batching window (50ms for low-latency flows), and quantization profile if they opt for smaller models.
- Pre-kickoff validation script (Monica) — smoke test that runs user flows, validates structured JSON output shape against schema-v1.json.
- Post-UAT metrics template (Marcus) — token-level latency/95/99, error counts, tool-call success rate.

Notes / blockers
- We need MedIntel to confirm the exact parser fields they must receive unchanged (they mentioned a parser; ask Priya to highlight immutable fields).
- If they require on-prem or VPC testing we’ll need to escalate to sales/solutions for contract addendum; assume hosted pilot unless asked.

Connor — can you draft the adapter examples by Friday 9/24 so I can include them in the kickoff doc? Marcus — can you provision the namespace by Monday 9/27 morning?

Thanks,
Monica

Subject: Re: Pilot: Runtime callflow & structured output pilot — kickoff

Hi Sanjeev / Priya —

Great kickoff today — thanks for the alignment. Per our discussion, confirming the agreed MAP and next steps:

Confirmed dates
- Namespace provisioned: 2027-09-27 (complete)
- Schema freeze: 2027-10-04 (MedIntel to confirm final immutable fields by then)
- Integration sprint window: 2027-10-11 → 2027-10-15
- UAT + load sweep: 2027-10-18 → 2027-10-22
- Closeout presentation: 2027-10-25

Immediate action items (owners)
- MedIntel: finalize immutable parser fields in Drive doc (Priya) — due 2027-10-04
- Redwood/Connor: push reference adapter to the kickoff Drive folder and open a small repo (link below) — ETA 2027-09-24 (done)
- Redwood/Marcus: switched pilot namespace to include 30-day trace retention and token metrics export to the shared Drive — done
- Redwood/Monica: upload pre-kick smoke tests and pass criteria into the Drive doc — ETA 2027-10-01

Attachments / links
- Pilot runbook: redwood-pilot-plan.pdf
- Schema we’ll validate against: schema-v1.json
- Shared Drive (kickoff + runbook + adapter): https://drive.redwood.com/drive/pilot-MID-4829
- Scoped pilot contract (for signature if they decide to go Dedicated after): pilot-scoped-contract.pdf (attached)

Please reply if anything above is incorrect. If not, we’ll mark the MAP as agreed and Monica will start the pre-kick smoke tests tomorrow.

Thanks again — excited to get this live.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Customer Success, Redwood Inference
